intro: Disrupting Logistics tasks adventurers with blunting a full-scale Al'Aketh cultist assault in the Gustberry Lowlands. By eliminating the enemy healers who sustain the frontline brawlers, players help beleaguered local defenders turn the tide before their lines collapse.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... By the winds.
You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.
